clipboard.description: Clipboard backend. Defaults to arboard; command sends the text to a shell command's stdin.

language.description: Languages keyed by name. The executable language customizes the executable-file fallback.

root.description: Workspace root. Expands a leading ~ to HOME; relative paths resolve from the current directory.

setup.description: Shell commands to run after copying each template.

oneOf.description: Use the system clipboard through arboard.
Pipe the text to a shell command.

command.description: Shell command receiving UTF-8 text on stdin, without an added newline.

compile.description: Compilation shell command with shell-quoted {input} and {binary} paths. Omit for interpreted languages.

extensions.description: File extensions without the leading dot. Use [] for the executable fallback.

preprocess.description: Shell command before compilation, execution, or submission. Receives source on stdin and via {input}; writes transformed UTF-8 source to stdout.

presubmit.description: Shell command before submission, after preprocess. Receives source on stdin and via {input}; writes transformed UTF-8 source to stdout.

profile.description: Named compile/run overrides selected with --profile. Omitted commands inherit language settings.

run.description: Execution shell command with shell-quoted {input} and {binary} paths.

submit.description: Submission language IDs keyed by service (atcoder or yukicoder). AtCoder Problems uses atcoder. IDs must be strings.

compile.description: Override the compilation shell command. Supports {input} and {binary}.

run.description: Override the execution shell command. Supports {input} and {binary}.

contest.description: Run after copying the contest template, in the contest root.

problem.description: Run after copying the problem template, in each problem directory.

single_problem.description: Run after copying the single problem template, in the standalone problem root.

workspace.description: Run after copying the workspace template, in the standalone problem or contest root.

SetupCommands.description: One shell command or multiple commands run in order in separate shells. Use [] to run none.
